_about: Content of the in-app Guide. Every phrase under tryIt and groups[].examples is checked by tests/test_guide_commands.py: it must be handled by Seven's instant layers (no language model), and when 'expect' is set the reply must carry that action. 'live' phrases depend on this PC's files and are skipped. Change a phrase here and the test tells you if Seven no longer understands it.

tryIt.title: Max your brightness
tryIt.detail: Seven changes your screen brightness directly.

tryIt.title: Open Chrome
tryIt.detail: Any installed app, by its everyday name.

tryIt.title: Put them side by side
tryIt.say: Put Chrome and File Explorer side by side
tryIt.detail: Seven arranges windows for you. Open both first.

tryIt.title: Set the volume
tryIt.detail: Exact levels, louder, quieter or mute.

tryIt.title: Ask about your PC
tryIt.detail: Seven reads your hardware live, no internet needed.

tryIt.title: Start a timer
tryIt.detail: Alerts you even when Seven is hidden.

groups.title: Apps and windows
groups.summary: Seven has hands. It opens and closes apps, folders and sites, and moves windows around your screens.

groups.title: System controls
groups.summary: Volume, brightness, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, dark mode, night light, do not disturb, airplane mode, media keys and battery.

groups.title: Knows your computer
groups.summary: Ask about your processor, graphics card, memory and drives. Answers come from live readings on this PC.

examples.say: How much RAM do I have
How full is my C drive

groups.title: Find files
groups.summary: Seven indexes your drives and finds files by name or by what is inside documents, then opens the best match.

groups.title: Workspaces and triggers
groups.summary: Save the apps, windows and tabs you have open as a workspace and bring them all back with one sentence. Triggers run your own phrases or hotkeys.

groups.title: Tasks
groups.summary: A to-do list you can fill by voice, with due dates, priorities and subtasks.

examples.say: Add a task to call the bank tomorrow

groups.title: Reminders, alarms and timers
groups.summary: One-off or repeating. They fire as a notification even when the Seven window is closed.

examples.say: Remind me to stretch in 20 minutes
Every Monday remind me to submit the report at 9am

groups.title: Memory
groups.summary: Tell Seven about yourself once. It remembers, updates facts when you correct it, and shows everything it knows on the Memory page.

examples.say: Remember that my favorite editor is VS Code

groups.title: Change Seven by talking
groups.summary: Every setting can be changed in plain words. Seven confirms the new value and the old one.
